test_cases.name: hero_review_caps_laws
test_cases.input: Review this pricing hero. It has four equal buttons: Start free, Book a demo, See pricing, Talk to sales. The recommended plan is not marked.
assertions: Cites Hick's Law for the four equal CTAs and tells the user to keep one primary
Cites von Restorff or serial position for the unmarked recommended plan, not as a duplicate of the CTA finding
Does not claim a conversion-rate lift
Does not list unrelated laws such as Doherty or Parkinson's without evidence

test_cases.name: poster_uses_renderer
test_cases.input: Turn this landing-page review into an annotated poster like a callout sheet.
assertions: Writes schema 2.0 findings with stable IDs, evidence, one principle, severity, confidence, recommendation, verification, side, and anchor
Runs scripts/render_review.py and returns the HTML file
Caps the poster at 14 cards and groups overlapping laws into one finding
Uses a screenshot as the plate when one was provided, otherwise labels the wireframe as neutral

test_cases.name: compare_preserves_evidence
test_cases.input: Compare this revised checkout with the earlier UX review and show what was resolved or introduced.
assertions: Preserves stable finding IDs for the same issue
Separates resolved, changed, new, and unchanged findings
Does not call an issue resolved without new observable evidence
Runs scripts/compare_reviews.py for the deterministic classification

test_cases.name: form_postel_and_fitts
test_cases.input: The phone field rejects 555-0100 and (555) 555-0100. The submit button is a 12px text link at the top of a long form.
assertions: Cites Postel's Law for rejecting predictable phone formats and says to accept then normalize
Cites Fitts's Law for target size and distance, including minimize target distance as a Fitts rule rather than a separate law
Does not treat the case as a WCAG conformance audit

test_cases.name: does_not_own_tokens
test_cases.input: Pick a type scale and rename these BEM classes.
assertions: Does not run the Laws of UX review workflow
Says this skill does not own tokens or CSS naming
